metadata.description: Claude Code + Codex on one project: OpenAI's Codex plugin, a Codex round launcher that can't lose its answer, a headless-Chrome kit and a guide to self-guided product demos.

plugins.name: agent-bridge
plugins.description: codex-ask (Codex rounds with saved request, reply and decision), browser-check (real-browser checks of a web app) and guided-demo (building a self-guided product demo with an in-app tour). Installs OpenAI's codex plugin with it.
